task_definition.task_description: Please check Hilton Tokyo, then book a deluxe room there for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-13. After that, get the weather for Tokyo, Japan, prepare and publish a high-priority in-app weather brief and alert card for me, then look up headphones in electronics, get recommendations based on the Sony XM5 option, check out the best recommendation, and finally send me a high-priority app notification that the hotel booking, weather notice, and travel-related product purchase are complete.

user_input.query: Please check Hilton Tokyo and book a deluxe room for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-13. After that, get the weather for Tokyo, Japan and prepare and publish a high-priority in-app weather brief and alert card for me on the app channel. Then look up headphones in the electronics category, use the Sony XM5 option with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk to generate recommendations, choose the best recommendation, and check out 1 unit. Finally, send a high-priority app notification confirming that the hotel booking, weather notice, and travel-related product purchase are complete for user_01.
